branchProtection._comment: Read by scripts/install/setup-branch-protection.sh (#8103). Since #12106 the one required context is `CI Result`, the always-run aggregate that needs every ci.yml job and fails when any failed, was cancelled, or was skipped because Detect Changes did not run. The live ruleset must be switched to this list (rerun setup-branch-protection.sh) when the job merge that removed the Structural Checks / Daemon Checks contexts lands: a required context that never reports blocks every merge.
